summary: Added 27 confirmed events (mostly mid-summer, the period that was thinnest) and pruned 6 finished 28 Jun rows. Biggest win: filled the long-standing Canbury Bandstand gap by OCR-reading the official CARA 2026 season poster - 8 free Sunday concerts (5 Jul-6 Sep). Also added the free Southbank Appearing Rooms water-play fountain, the free family Saxon Fayre (25 Jul), Rose family/theatre (As You Like It, Una Coello toddler singalong, Room on the Broom), cornerHOUSE music/theatre (Coda, Attitude summer shows), and a Surbiton Partnership sweep of music/comedy/folk/nature-walk events. Upgraded the placeholder 4 Aug talk to the confirmed Bayeux Tapestry talk. The Lamb and Kingston Libraries summer programme stayed empty: their dated listings are Instagram/Facebook- or app-only and not fetchable - flagged for a manual/screenshot pass.
